players.bio: Abdelhamid Aït Boudlal (born 16 April 2006) is a Moroccan footballer who plays as a central defender for French Ligue 1 club Rennes and the Morocco national team. Club career On 11 October 2023, Aït Boudlal was named by English newspaper The Guardian as one of the best players born in 2006 worldwide.

Adrien Thomasson (born 10 December 1993) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Lens. Career Born in Savoie, Thomasson began playing youth football with local Evian before turning professional with the club's senior side. He plays as a central midfielder, but played on the left flank, notably while on loan at Vannes.

Alidu Seidu (born 4 June 2000) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a defender for French Ligue 1 club Rennes and the Ghana national team. Professional career On 1 June 2019, Alidu Seidu joined Clermont Foot from the JMG Academy. He made his debut with Clermont in a 1–1 Ligue 2 draw with Toulouse FC on 19 September 2020.
Anthony Rouault (born 29 May 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Rennes.
Arnaud Dominique Nordin (born 17 June 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for Bundesliga club Mainz 05.
Boulaye Dia (born 16 November 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A side Lazio on loan from Salernitana. Born in France, he represents the Senegal national team.
Brice Lauriche Samba (born 25 April 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Rennes. Born in the Republic of Congo, he plays for the France national team.
Bryan Keith Reynolds Jr. (born June 28, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a right-back for Belgian Pro League club Westerlo and the United States national team.
Charlie Richard Cresswell (born 17 August 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Toulouse.

Djaoui Cissé (born 31 January 2004) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Rennes. Club career A youth product of US Grigny, Cissé joined the youth academy of Rennes in 2019 and was promoted to their reserves in 2021. On 2 February 2024, he signed his first professional contract with Rennes until 2027.

Eliezer Mayenda is a 21-year-old Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for French Ligue 1 club Stade Rennais FC, having completed a permanent transfer from Sunderland on 5 July 2026. Mayenda holds Spanish nationality. On 4 February 2022, he was called up to the Spain under-17s for the Torneio Internacional Algarve U17, a youth tournament held in Portugal.

Esteban Lepaul (born 18 April 2000) is a French professional footballer who plays as a striker for Ligue 1 club Rennes. Early career Lepaul began his youth career by playing for Baldenheim, Colmar and Nancy before he was recruited to the Lyon football academy in 2015. Club career In August 2020, Lepaul joined Championnat National 2 club Épinal.

Franck Armel Gérard Haise (born 15 April 1971) is a French professional football manager and former player who is currently the head coach of Ligue 1 club Rennes. As a player, he was a midfielder, spending most of his career in Ligue 2.

Issa Soumaré (born 10 October 2000) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a forward for French Ligue 1 club Le Havre. Club career On 22 October 2019, Soumaré signed a professional contract with Orléans for four years. He debuted for Orléans in a 2–1 Ligue 2 loss to Stade Malherbe Caen on 1 November 2019.
Ludovic Régis Arsène Blas (born 31 December 1997) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Rennes.

Mahamadou Aboubakar Nagida (born 28 June 2005) is a Cameroonian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Ligue 1 club Rennes and the Cameroon national team. Playing career Nagida is a youth product of the Cameroonian academy Ecole de Football Brasseries du Cameroun. On 21 August 2023, Nagida transferred to the Ligue 1 club Rennes on a 5-year contract.
Mahdi Cherno Philippe Camara (born 30 June 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Rennes.

Musa Mohammad Sulaiman Al-Taamari (Arabic: مُوسى مُحَمَّد مُوسى سُلَيْمَان التَعمري; born 10 June 1997), also spelled as Mousa Al-Tamari, is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Ligue 1 club Rennes and the Jordan national team. In the 2023 AFC Asian Cup, Al-Tamari led his country to their first ever final.

Przemysław Adam Frankowski (born 12 April 1995) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a wing-back for Ligue 1 club Rennes, on loan from Süper Lig club Galatasaray, and the Poland national team.
Quentin Merlin (born 16 May 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for Ligue 1 club Rennes.
Sebastian Szymański (born 10 May 1999) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or a winger for Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe and the Poland national team.
Valentin Rongier (born 7 December 1994) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Rennes.
